description: How a pane state is shown: the palette role of its dot, whether a turn is running in it (the agent can be stopped, typing queues, the header counts time), and the word at the header's trailing edge. The Mac (PaneState.dot, isTurnRunning, AgentPaneStatusPresentation) and the desktop client (PaneState::dot, is_turn_running, agent::status_word) pass every case. The dot roles and the running set are defined once in x-clientPolicy paneStates; this file fixes what they come to. A palette role is resolved by each client: success, accent, warning, muted or secondary. terminalNotices fixes the line above a terminal's screen: the exit status of a dead process decides whether the line informs or warns (a clean exit never warns; a failed or interrupted one does), so a finished one-shot command such as an agent sign-in does not read as a failure.
